svg.title: Benefitline architecture
svg.text: The model asks, the rules engine decides
One AgentCore runtime in us-east-1. Every amount comes from policyengine-us 2.0.4, never from a language model.
STRANDS GRAPH, THREE NODES IN PARALLEL
each amount carries its rule URL
AND condition on all three edges
the only interrupt, one tap answers
a repeat answer becomes an org rule
one row per family, what is filed
Guard hooks, enforced in code and not in prompts
MaskUntilClaimed / NoIdentifiersOut denies SSN and A-number / TraceRedactor / LedgerWriter
model call: Haiku or Sonnet on Bedrock
the decider and the one interrupt
Demo households are fictional. Amounts are estimates and the agency decides. Every number on screen carries the rule URL the engine used.
